## Bensebaini Heads Algeria to Victory

Ramy Bensebaini also had reason to celebrate: The captain of the Algerian national team scored the decisive goal in the 1-0 victory over Togo. In the 76th minute, he headed in a cross from Anis Hadj Moussa, securing three crucial points for his team in the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers. With this win, Algeria extended its lead at the top of the table to seven points. Zambia follows with four points, while Togo has three points.

Advertisement [...] Mathis Albert came on in the closing stages of the U.S.'s 6-0 away win over Haiti. In the first leg of the quarterfinals of the 2026/27 CONCACAF Nations League, the 17-year-old BVB prospect came on as a substitute in the 81st minute for former Dortmund player Christian Pulisic. At that point, the United States was already leading 5-0.
